ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Download From Direct IP Via Bitsadmin
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of bitsadmin downloading a file using an URL that contains an IP

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "bitsadmin\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/transfer\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/addfile\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/2.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/3.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/4.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/5.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/6.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/7.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/8.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/9.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/7\\-.*"))
